critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in POS InvoiceHeader branch <select> and ManagersSection branch <select>. Not part of this diff but affects both spots — likely the emergent visual-editor injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Consider unwrapping the label expression so no span is rendered inside options.

Manager section console shows several 403s on /staff (e.g. StaffLeaderboard / LeaveApprovals / PendingSignups panels) — expected because these owner-only panels still fetch even though manager sees the page; UI degrades gracefully. Consider conditionally rendering/fetching for role==='manager' to silence console noise.
